tools.name: check_status
tools.description: Check system health: runtime state, Personal Server connection, and connected source status

tools.name: list_sources
tools.description: List available data sources that can be connected for personal data collection

tools.name: show_data
tools.description: Inspect or read collected data for a connected source. Without `scope` it returns an overview: summary, sync state, file path, and every scope with its item count and size in bytes (no data). With `scope` it returns one page of that scope's items: `offset` (default 0) and `limit` (default 20, max 500) page through them, `query` keeps only items whose JSON contains the text (case-insensitive). A page never exceeds about 100 KB; when more remain the result gives `nextOffset` to pass next.

scope.description: Scope to read, as listed in the overview (e.g. github.repositories, or just repositories). Omit for the overview.

offset.description: Index of the first item to return (default 0)

limit.description: Maximum items to return (default 20); the size cap may return fewer

query.description: Case-insensitive text filter: keep only items whose JSON contains it

tools.name: connect_source
tools.description: Connect a platform and collect personal data. Runs the full connect flow: setup, authentication, data collection, and sync

tools.name: run_diagnostics
tools.description: Run detailed system diagnostics: CLI version, runtime paths, browser state, connector cache, and source-level issues
